data.name: Arko
data.gender_notes: Arko is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arko is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arka’, meaning the Sun. The name Arko is a symbol of light, wisdom, and strength. It is believed that those named Arko are endowed with the qualities of the Sun, including intelligence, strength, and courage. The name Arko carries the meaning “Sun, Light, Intelligence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Arko usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, light, intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arko is a powerful and spiritual name that is rooted in Hindu mythology. It is believed that the name Arko is associated with the Sun God, Surya, and is a symbol of enlightenment, wisdom, and power.
data.etymology: Arko belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Light, Intelligence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arko total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
